svg.data-weight-note: 51.2 lb (23.22 kg) chassis. Fan module 1.35 lb (0.61 kg). Supply 3.6 lb (1.63 kg), one row for the 3200 W AC/HVDC, AC exhaust and DC/HVDC supplies.
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 120 V or 200 to 240 V at 16 A max, 50/60 Hz (3200 W AC/HVDC)
svg.data-power-input-hvdc: 240 VDC at 14.5 max (3200 W AC/HVDC and DC/HVDC)
svg.data-power-supply-options: 3200W AC/HVDC port-side intake, 3200W AC port-side exhaust, or 3200W DC/HVDC port-side intake (two)
svg.data-altitude: 0 to 10,000 ft (3,048 m) operating; 6,562 ft (2000 m) for China
svg.data-optics-qsfp-dd: guide: "400-Gigabit QSFP-DD ports (48)". Table 1, 3200 W supplies, 40 C ambient limit, 48 ports MACsec enabled: 20 W on ports 3, 6, 9 ... 48 (and 26, 29, 32, 35, 38, 41, 47 as printed) and 12 W on the remaining 24
svg.data-management-ports: front figure: one RJ-45 and one SFP management port, and a console port

rect.data-members: console mgmt-rj45 mgmt-sfp usb led-bcn led-sts led-env
